_about: Western and frontier: dusty towns, the railroad coming, outlaws, the law, and who owns the land and water. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

town: a silver camp that grew too fast
a cattle town at the end of the trail
a river crossing with one ferry
a railroad camp of tents and saloons
a border town where two flags fly
a ghost town with one family left
water_owner: a cattle baron with hired guns
a widow who will not sell
a mining outfit poisoning the creek
a native nation whose treaty is being ignored
a banker in the next territory
nobody yet, and everyone is racing
a preacher who calls it god's water
outlaw: a gang that robs only the railroad
a young gun out to make a name
a former soldier who cannot stop fighting
a woman who robs banks in a wedding veil
an old outlaw who wants one last pardon
a horse thief who is everyone's cousin
a hired killer with a list
the town's own founder, under another name
law: a marshal from back east who knows no one
a judge who hangs first and asks later
a deputy who used to ride with the gang
no law at all, only the saloon owner
a lawman the town elected to keep quiet
bounty hunters who answer to the money
a law that only protects the company
debt: a loan on the ranch due at harvest
a life saved in the war
a gambling marker held by the wrong man
a promise to a dying partner
a stolen horse that must be paid back
wages owed to a crew of rail workers
a family name that must be cleared
a ransom that was never paid
showdown_place: a canyon where the train slows
the dry riverbed under a full moon
the water tower above the rail yard

cliches: the corrupt mayor in a top hat
the native guide who exists to help the hero
